Messages.Author: Michael Gerdau
Messages.Body:
I have the following question regarding Mask of 1000 Faces:
I start a bleed with a vamp that owning a Laptop and sup. OBFUSCATE. That
vamp plays sup. Faceless Night to leave the blocker tapped.
Eventually the bleed is taken over by another vamp with inf. OBF. and no
Laptop.

Is the Laptop still in effect, i.e. does the new vamp still bleed for 2 ?
Is the sup Faceless Night still in effect or is it changes to inf. ?

There are certainly some more combinations that I haven't mentioned, e.g.
a similar question arises once you play inf. Faceless Night and switch
over to a sup OBFUSCATE vamp. Was it now sup. Faceless Night ?

Michael

Messages.Author: Rory
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 29 Jun 1996 23:05:28 +0200, michael...@elmshorn.netsurf.de
(Michael Gerdau) wrote:

>I have the following question regarding Mask of 1000 Faces:
>I start a bleed with a vamp that owning a Laptop and sup. OBFUSCATE. That
>vamp plays sup. Faceless Night to leave the blocker tapped.
>Eventually the bleed is taken over by another vamp with inf. OBF. and no
>Laptop.

>Is the Laptop still in effect, i.e. does the new vamp still bleed for 2 ?
>Is the sup Faceless Night still in effect or is it changes to inf. ?

The laptop is not in effect since it is part of the minion who is no
longer.
The faceless night is still in effect since it is an action modifier
and works until after the action is completed or prevented.

>There are certainly some more combinations that I haven't mentioned, e.g.
>a similar question arises once you play inf. Faceless Night and switch
>over to a sup OBFUSCATE vamp. Was it now sup. Faceless Night ?

No because the action takes effect when the mod is played. Similarly
the masking vampire may not have dominate but if the original one did
and played say a conditioning that would still be in effect.
Rory

Now that is an interesting and good question.
I bleieve the answer will be that Mask cannot be played after AI but
would like Tom to give us a ruling.
If it was a reaction card then you could do it but as AI is an out of

This would affect other cards as well such as Brujah Frenzy but it
would be likely to only come up with an AI card since a S&B deck might
have the Mask and others would be unlikely.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ni...@rci.rogers.com writes:
>What happens if the following situation: a vampire with +1 bleed attempts to
>bleed with a laptop and J.S. Simmons. (4 bleed in total) The player being bled
>plays Archon Investigation. Can Mask be played after AI has been played, or
>does AI immediately burn the vampire with 4 bleed with no chance of Mask being
>played?

AI burns the bleeder immediately. There is no "response" (fast-effect stack)
in VtES. Everything happens as the cards are played, except for actions
which "happen" when the action resolves successfully (and as otherwise
specified on card text, of course :-).
